native_profile.bio: Rachel has exuded an entrepreneurial spirit since the beginning of her career. Her genuine interest in business coupled with her strong business acumen always add value to her clients and have been the fundamental driving force behind her continued success with everything she chooses to undertake. With over 17 years of experience in the Events & Exhibitions industry, Rachel has mastered a transferable skill set enabling her to identify, recruit, train and develop performing teams of over 30 in multiple locations. Rachel leads by example and has delivered multi- million dollar events successfully over and over again due to the thorough grasp of the market and ultimately meeting and exceeding the needs and expectations of her clients. Rachel lives and breathes events and is passionate about successful event deliveries, which she culminates into Long lasting relationships. Over the years, Rachel has developed successful client relationships with C-level decision executives from various industries, HNIs, UHNWIs, diplomats, government authorities from across the globe and has decided to start a new chapter of her life where she has founded and fully conceptualise the realisation of UNFOLD, Art Beyond the BRICS which led to the formation of UNFOLD Art XChange, an unparalleled B2B Art business conférence and summits platform. https://www.artemholdings.com.Rachel is fluent in English, Chinese (Mandarin) and French and currently resides in Dubai.
